institution: LALIGA Business School, Madrid (título acreditado por la Universidad Alfonso X el Sabio)
programme_name: Máster en Organización de Eventos Deportivos
official_status: TÍTULO PROPIO — page label «Máster de Formación Permanente y Acreditado por [Universidad Alfonso X el Sabio]». Máster de Formación Permanente is the post-RD 822/2021 legal name for a título propio: no ANECA verification, no RUCT entry, no PhD access, normally ineligible for public postgraduate scholarships. No RUCT code is printed anywhere on the page.
start_date_verbatim: Programme fact strip, verbatim: «Fecha FEB 2027 · Duración 6 meses · Modalidad Presencial · Idioma ESPAÑOL». Month and year only — no day of month is published.
intakes_per_year: NOT FOUND — the page prints a single start (FEB 2027) and does not state how many cohorts run per year. It is a 6-month programme, so a February start is the programme's own calendar, not a second cohort of an October one.
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: NOT FOUND — no admission or enrolment closing date is published; the page routes to an admissions contact form and to Banco Santander financing agreements instead.
modality: Presencial — LALIGA Business School campus, Madrid
language_of_instruction: Español — «Idioma ESPAÑOL» in the fact strip
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND — no price figure published; the page shows financing options only
evidence_verbatim: Fecha FEB 2027 | Duración 6 meses | Modalidad Presencial | Idioma ESPAÑOL
notes: A genuine spring (February 2027) start, but note the trade-offs: (a) título propio, so no PhD access and no public funding; (b) SPORTS events, not music/live-entertainment — path S by subject matter but tangential to the candidate's music focus; (c) 6 months only, and Spanish-taught, which is a hard filter at A0/A1 Spanish; (d) a 6-month presential título propio is a weak basis for a Spanish long-stay study visa (visado de estudios normally expects a full academic course). Day of month and application deadline both need a human to ask admissions.

institution: EAE Business School Madrid (double award with Universidad Internacional de la Empresa, UNIE)
programme_name: Máster en Dirección y Organización de Eventos / Master in Events Management and Organization
official_status: MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO (OFFICIAL) for the UNIE half of the double award — RUCT 4318070, «Máster Universitario en Dirección y Organización de Eventos / Master in Management and Organization of Events por la Universidad Internacional de la Empresa», estado «Publicado en B.O.E.». The page states the student receives «a double qualification: the Master in Events Management and Organization from EAE Business School and the Master in Events Management and Organization from the Universidad Internacional de la Empresa (UNIE)» and calls the credential «Titulación oficial». NOTE the contrast with EAE BARCELONA's similarly named programme, which prints no RUCT code and is a título propio.
start_date_verbatim: Programme listing, verbatim: «Oct. 2026 - 10 months». October is the only start month printed anywhere on the page; no February, January or April cohort is advertised.
intakes_per_year: 1 (October), on the evidence of the page
language_of_instruction: Español — explicit statement on the page: «This master's degree is taught in SPANISH». Do not be misled by the English-language version of the page.
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND — no price figure published (discount and financing messaging only)
evidence_verbatim: Oct. 2026 - 10 months  ///  This master's degree is taught in SPANISH
notes: Checked BECAUSE it is the official (RUCT 4318070) sibling of EAE Barcelona's título propio of nearly the same name — the officiality asymmetry between the two campuses is real and is confirmed here. But there is NO spring cohort: single October start. Spanish-only teaching.

institution: Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB) — Escola Universitària de Turisme i Direcció Hotelera / Facultat d'Economia i Empresa
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Dirección y Organización de Turismo de Eventos / Direcció i Organització de Turisme d'Esdeveniments
official_status: MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO (OFFICIAL) — RUCT 4313799, «Máster Universitario en Dirección y Organización de Turismo de Eventos por la Universidad Autónoma de Barcelona», estado «Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)». Listed by UAB under «la oferta de másteres oficiales». Unusual for this field: most events masters in Spain are títulos propios.
start_date_verbatim: UAB official-master fact sheet, verbatim fields: «Inicio de clases: 07/10/2026 · Fin de clases: 12/05/2027 · Plazas: 35 · Horarios: Tarde». A single annual cohort; no February, January or April start is offered.
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: N/A — no spring intake. ⚠️ TRAP AVOIDED: UAB's preinscription OPENS on «12/01/2026» (12 January) and the fact sheet shows «Estado de la preinscripción: Abierta». That is a JANUARY APPLICATION WINDOW for an OCTOBER START — explicitly excluded by the SPRING-BRIEF, and exactly the pattern that gets miscounted as a spring intake.
language_of_instruction: «Castellano (70%) e inglés (30%)» — verbatim from the UAB fact sheet. Predominantly Spanish; the English share is a minority of teaching.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 7,980 for the full 60 ECTS — computed from the UAB fact sheet's «Comunitarios: 133 €/crédito, incluye tasas y seguro escolar. Extracomunitarios: 133 €/crédito, incluye tasas y seguro escolar» (133 x 60 = 7,980). Arithmetic shown per brief rule. Rates as published on the page on 2026-08-29 for the 2026-27 cohort.
evidence_verbatim: Inicio de clases 07/10/2026 — Fin de clases 12/05/2027 — Inicio de la preinscripción 12/01/2026 — Estado de la preinscripción: Abierta
notes: NOTABLE SECONDARY FINDING for the wider dataset: UAB prints the SAME per-credit price for «Comunitarios» and «Extracomunitarios» (133 €/crédito each) on this title — i.e. NO non-EU surcharge on this programme, contrary to the pattern at several other Catalan and Madrid publics. Worth carrying into the main record. On the spring question the answer is a clean NO.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Organización y Dirección de Eventos
official_status: MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO (OFFICIAL) — RUCT 4317016, «Máster Universitario en Organización y Dirección de Eventos por la Universidad Antonio de Nebrija», estado «Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)». The RUCT code is NOT printed on the programme page; confirmed from the register, not from the page.
start_date_verbatim: Programme page, verbatim: «De octubre a junio». No day-of-month start date is printed, and no second convocatoria of any kind is advertised — the only calendar shown is the single October-to-June academic year.
intakes_per_year: 1 (October), on the evidence of the page
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: N/A — no spring intake. The page says «Inscripciones abiertas» (rolling admission). ⚠️ Per the SPRING-BRIEF this is explicitly NOT a spring intake: rolling admission with a single autumn start does not count.
modality: «Presencial, Online» — both modalities run the same October-to-June calendar
language_of_instruction: «Español» — explicit «Idioma de impartición» field on the page
tuition_total_eur: EUR 9,200 presencial / EUR 5,260 online — verbatim «Presencial: 9.200 € / Online: 5.260 €», for 60 ECTS. Rates as published 2026-08-29; the page does not state which academic year they apply to, so treat the year as unconfirmed.
evidence_verbatim: De octubre a junio — 60 ECTS — Modalidad: Presencial, Online — Idioma: Español — Presencial: 9.200 € / Online: 5.260 €
notes: Rolling year-round enrolment («Inscripciones abiertas») is the thing most likely to be misread as a spring intake here; it is not one. Spanish-only, which is a hard filter at A0/A1.
